question: Identify the top 10 liquor categories in Iowa in 2021 by calculating, for each category, the average of the per-liter retail prices across all sales transactions in that category during 2021. For these top categories, provide their average per-liter retail prices calculated in the same manner for the years 2019, 2020, and 2021.
sql:
WITH top_10_2021 AS (
  SELECT category_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2021
    AND volume_sold_liters > 0
  GROUP BY category_name
  ORDER BY AVG(sale_dollars / volume_sold_liters) DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
category_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    s.category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) AS year,
    AVG(s.sale_dollars / NULLIF(s.volume_sold_liters, 0)) AS avg_per_liter_retail_price
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales` s
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    AND s.volume_sold_liters > 0
    AND s.category_name IN (SELECT category_name FROM top_10_2021)
  GROUP BY s.category_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date)
)
SELECT 
  category_name,
  AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2019 THEN avg_per_liter_retail_price END) AS avg_per_liter_retail_price_2019,
  AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN avg_per_liter_retail_price END) AS avg_per_liter_retail_price_2020,
  AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN avg_per_liter_retail_price END) AS avg_per_liter_retail_price_2021
FROM category_avgs
GROUP BY category_name
ORDER BY avg_per_liter_retail_price_2021 DESC
